scope: Prove the complete ten-step first-run wizard from a fresh browser through visible profile creation, synthetic resume upload and fact review, user preferences, enabled Greenhouse source, saved job-title search, manual-only automation choice, and a positive first search.

environment.source_transport: production Greenhouse adapter with in-process httpx.MockTransport responses; browser egress blocked
environment.delivery: local-only; no push or hosted automation

acceptance: A fresh browser starts without a profile. The user creates one through the profile form and the saved profile is read back with no invented career facts.

The user uploads a synthetic PDF through Resume history. The production upload and extraction routes parse the file and show proposed facts for review; extracted contact data is not selected by default.
The user adds extracted career facts to the profile, sees them remain Pending and unchecked, explicitly verifies and approves them, saves, and confirms durable API readback after reload.
The user selects REMOTE work arrangements and a per-job application-route preference. The first-run flow records the explicit choice to leave AI disabled.
The user adds and enables a public Greenhouse board through Sources, creates an enabled Python Engineer saved search scoped to that source, and chooses manual review only.

The user runs the selected saved search. The supported Greenhouse adapter normalizes and persists one synthetic Python Engineer posting; profile search history reports COMPLETED with results=1 and the Jobs view shows the posting after reload.
The wizard reports all ten steps Complete. Browser egress is blocked, no live provider request is sent, and no application submission occurs.

Cross-device persistence of browser-local first-run acknowledgments.
limitations: This PASS covers the ten-step MJ-REQ-250 first-run workflow in the local synthetic environment. It does not claim whole-product release eligibility or live provider availability.
Greenhouse was added and enabled through the user interface, but provider responses were mocked locally to prevent network access.
Issue #251 remains open pending local-only source synchronization; no push.
